text: Assumption: Without an explicit executor, the handler is executed in the internal context of the communication management — is this correct?

assumption: Without an explicit executor, the handler is executed in the internal context of the communication management.
rationale: SWS_CM_00093 has no executor parameter, whereas the overload SWS_CM_00094 specifically adds one.
